scope: Bounded D02 pilot for USGS Moon Unified Geologic Map v2 and USGS SIM 3464 Jezero/Nili Planum map units. Only source codes observed in the committed pilot record are mapped; every other code stays unmapped until it is reviewed against its own official legend.

igneous.label: Igneous
igneous.meaning: Mapped or documented evidence for igneous rock formation (volcanic or plutonic).
igneous.required_evidence: Official map unit name/description or documented interpretation that states an igneous origin.

impact.label: Impact
impact.meaning: Mapped or documented evidence for impact-crater formation or impact deposits.
impact.required_evidence: Official map unit family/name/description that states an impact-crater origin. Morphology alone does not establish impact melt, breccia or shock-mineral abundance.

sedimentary.label: Sedimentary
sedimentary.meaning: Mapped or documented evidence for sedimentary deposition or sedimentary landforms.
sedimentary.required_evidence: Official map unit name/description or documented interpretation that states a depositional sedimentary process (for example deltaic, lacustrine, fluvial or eolian).

aqueous_alteration.label: Aqueous alteration
aqueous_alteration.meaning: Mapped or documented evidence for aqueous alteration (hydrated or clay mineralogy, sulfate alteration).
aqueous_alteration.required_evidence: Official map unit description or documented interpretation that explicitly states aqueous/hydrated/clay/sulfate alteration. Iron-oxide or other spectral indicators alone are insufficient, and carbonate-bearing sedimentary rock does not by itself prove aqueous alteration.

policies.unknown_code: A raw code absent from its own dataset entry resolves to unmapped_code; it is never guessed from a similar code on another body or dataset.
policies.cross_body_equivalence: Raw codes are dataset-scoped. The same text code on Moon and Mars is not evidence of the same unit, process or material; there is no global code table.
policies.nonexclusive: A unit may carry zero, one or several process labels from different categories. Absence of a label is not evidence of absence.
policies.aqueous_alteration: Never inferred from iron oxides, hematite, goethite or spectral indices alone.
policies.no_numeric_similarity: Process labels are evidence only. This registry defines no geology similarity value and no combined six-dimension score.

usgs-moon-geology-v2.legend_source: USGS Unified Geologic Map of the Moon GIS v2: GeoUnits shapefile attributes plus the official DOMU descriptions CSV distributed in the same package.
usgs-moon-geology-v2.native_frame: Moon 2000 sphere, planetocentric latitude, east-positive longitude, LOLA control; no Earth WGS84.

process_labels.supporting_statement: Official DOMU unit name 'Eratosthenian Crater', source family 'Crater Unit' and description (non-rayed circular craters with sharp to partially subdued rim crests and circumferential ejecta) document a primary impact-crater unit. No impact-melt, breccia, ejecta thickness or shock-mineral abundance is inferred.
process_labels.source_document: USGS Unified Geologic Map of the Moon GIS v2, DOMU descriptions CSV (unit Ec) and GeoUnits attribute FIRST_Un_2

Ec.notes: Map-scale crater unit only; the 1:5,000,000 source cannot resolve local lithology or composition. Other DOMU codes remain unmapped in this pilot.

usgs-jezero-sim3464.legend_source: USGS SIM 3464 GIS GeoUnits_v1 attributes plus the official map-sheet descriptions (the distributed XML unit descriptions are empty).
usgs-jezero-sim3464.native_frame: Mars 2000 sphere, planetocentric latitude, east-positive longitude, body-fixed MTM zone 77.5E; no Earth WGS84.

process_labels.supporting_statement: Official SIM3464 unit name 'Crater rim unit' and description (high-relief scarps surrounding circular or quasicircular depressions) document an impact-crater rim landform. No impact-melt, breccia or shock-mineral abundance is inferred.
process_labels.source_document: USGS SIM 3464 map sheet, unit description for crater rim unit (symbol cr)

process_labels.supporting_statement: Official SIM3464 map-sheet interpretation identifies deltaic/lacustrine or alluvial/fluvial deposits for this fan unit; the mapped description documents stratified, lobate fan deposits at the mouth of Neretva Vallis. No grain size, mineralogy or aqueous-alteration assemblage is inferred from this label alone.
process_labels.source_document: USGS SIM 3464 map sheet and pamphlet interpretation for Jezero fan units

NHjf2.notes: Depositional fan interpretation only; mineralogy and alteration require separate evidence.

process_labels.supporting_statement: Official SIM3464 unit name 'Eolian bedform unit' and description (light-toned, linear, commonly parallel, low-relief ridges in local topographic lows) document wind-formed sedimentary bedforms. No grain size, composition or aqueous origin is inferred.
process_labels.source_document: USGS SIM 3464 map sheet, unit description for eolian bedform unit (symbol Aeb)

Aeb.notes: Eolian landform evidence only; not a mineral or aqueous-alteration observation.

Nue.notes: Official description documents an etched, rugged surficial unit without stating an igneous, impact, sedimentary or aqueous-alteration process. Kept mapped_without_process_evidence; no category is guessed.

Nle.notes: Official description documents an etched, rugged surficial unit without stating an igneous, impact, sedimentary or aqueous-alteration process. Kept mapped_without_process_evidence; no category is guessed.

Njf.notes: The description mentions impact craters on the surface but the unit itself is a floor unit, not an impact unit. No process label is assigned; crater counts are not impact-process evidence for the unit.
